project: Samsung SEVT - TTC Duc Hue 2 grid-connected DPPA economics
buyer_location: Yen Binh Industrial Park, Thai Nguyen province (north)

notes: SEVT total consumption is not public; modeled as a high-load-factor megafactory so the 70 GWh contracted slice is fully matched.

strike_basis.regulatory_cap_note: Decree 57 caps the grid-DPPA forward price at the RE-type ceiling generation tariff (Southern ground-mount no-storage ~1,012 VND/kWh). Sweep points above the ceiling are sensitivity-only.

assumptions.voltage_default_note: No public SEVT connection-voltage disclosure; 110 kV default.
